domain: LLM Architecture / Attention / State Space Models

api_runtime_policy.case2_api_tool_node_note: API feasibility checks are task nodes only when the experiment itself depends on hosted APIs.

select_when: broad domain context is needed before naming the method
paper is outside the domain core
reject_when: problem-gap sentence already provides enough context
adding context delays the named contribution
it would add implementation detail without changing the abstract argument
it turns the abstract into a result table
the chip does not support the claim

remove_or_repair: speed or efficiency claims without measured support
universality claims beyond the training/evaluation family
future-work claims not present as paper contributions

mcts_updates: Start from the required spine, not the full graph.
Add C1 only when the chip needs context before the object.
Add M2 when the central contribution depends on theory, mechanism, or efficiency.
Add E3 only when a compact supported evidence anchor improves the abstract.
Keep M1->E1 and E2->I1 as valid low-support escape routes.
Penalize table-like result dumps, unsupported numbers, and broad S1 claims.
audit_warning: Batch files preserve summary-level evidence, not complete raw evaluator transcripts for every sample. The next strict run should save one JSON transcript per sample.
